question:
Today, more and more tourists are visiting places where conditions are difficult such as the Sahara Desert or the Antarctic.
What are the benefits and disadvantages for tourists who visit such places?
essay:
Nowadays, many tourists travel to different regions in the world. The number of tourists who visit the areas with difficult conditions has increased over the past few years. Visiting such areas has pros and cons for tourists.

Tourists can gain benefits from visiting the area with difficult situations and conditions. First of all, since such areas are new and no one knows about them, it will afford tourists an opportunity to explore new things. Not only will tourists gain more information about these are and their creatures, but also the natural news and clean air with no noise refresh visitors. It is clear that being fresh is positively correlated with the visitors’ efficiency at workspace.

Further to these, it is a challenge for tourists to visit these areas. So they can gain experience in living in difficult situations, and this experience will act as a precursor to preparing them for future life.

On the other hand, living in these places has two disadvantages. First, if a tourist wants to visit such regions, he should provide a lot of things such as food, tent, and so for himself and will carry all stuff himself. So it is not easy for him and he will endure a several load for a heavy bag. Moreover, since no one has lived there for a long time, such areas are good places for dangerous animals to live there. So these regions are not safe for tourists, and animals such as snakes, tiger, bears and so one may hurt tourists.

To conclude, visiting regions with difficult situations benefits tourists in some ways such as discovering new things and gaining more experience, however, this trip has some disadvantages such as carry a heavy bag containing a lot of foof and other things, and existence of dangerous animals. I believe that the advantages of such trips easily outweigh the disadvantages of visiting such places.
